exposure: Chlorhexidine gluconate 4% (CHX) skin preparation and umbilical cord disinfection
Cases with cord blood T4 < 13 µg/dL
Povidone-iodine 10% (PVP-I) skin preparation and umbilical cord disinfection
outcome: Cord blood thyroid stimulating hormone (TSH) levels
cohort: 326 healthy mothers with term pregnancies who underwent cesarean section
finding: The incidence of elevated cord blood TSH (≥ 10 mIU/L) and low cord blood T4 (≤ 7.3 µg/dL) was significantly higher in newborns exposed to PVP-I compared to CHX for skin preparation and umbilical cord disinfection.
